name: CLAIM_REFERENCE_DATA
description: Table of Claim Reference Data collections, where each collection represents a single piece of received claim-related data.

columns.name: REF_DATA_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier for the Claim Reference Data record.

columns.name: RECORD_STATUS_C_NAME
columns.description: Stores the record status (hidden, soft-deleted, and others).

columns.name: ORGANIZATION_ID
columns.description: The ID of the organization that sent the invoice.

columns.name: ORGANIZATION_ID_EXTERNAL_NAME
columns.description: Organization's external name used as the display name on forms and user interfaces.

columns.name: PAT_ID
columns.description: The Patient ID of the member in the Payer system for whom the invoice was sent.

columns.name: MEMBER_IDENT
columns.description: The Member ID of the associated member for whom the invoice was sent.

columns.name: CRF_RECORD_TYPE_C_NAME
columns.description: The type of Claim Reference Data record. This is determined by the claims-related record the Claim Reference Data record will link to (Claim, Referal, or other).

columns.name: LINKED_CLAIM_ID
columns.description: The ID of the Claim record linked to the Claim Reference Data record.

columns.name: BILLING_PROV_NPI
columns.description: The NPI of the Billing Provider / Vendor that sent the invoice.

columns.name: BILLING_PROV_TAX_IDENT
columns.description: The Tax ID of the Billing Provider / Vendor that sent the invoice.

columns.name: BILLING_SYS_C_NAME
columns.description: The type of the Billing System that sent the invoice.

columns.name: HOSPITAL_ACCT_IDENT
columns.description: The external identifier of the Hospital Account associated with the invoice. This identifier should not be used to join to internal Hospital Account tables.

columns.name: CLAIM_INT_CONTROL_NUMBER
columns.description: The Internal Control Number (ICN) for the claim. Each ICN points to a unique Claim record in the Payer system.

columns.name: INVOICE_NUMBER
columns.description: The number of the invoice in the claim reference data set.

columns.name: CLAIM_FROM_DATE
columns.description: The minimum service date on the claim.

columns.name: CLAIM_TO_DATE
columns.description: The maximum service date on the claim.

columns.name: BILLED_AMOUNT
columns.description: The total of the charges on the claim.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_INVOICE_NUMBER
columns.description: The number of the original or previous invoice in a series of invoices where the previous invoice was canceled, replaced, resubmitted, or otherwise nullified.

columns.name: CANCEL_FLAG_C_NAME
columns.description: Flag raised if the associated invoice is a Cancellation.

columns.name: REPLACE_FLAG_C_NAME
columns.description: Flag raised if the associated invoice is a Replacement.

columns.name: RESUBMIT_FLAG_C_NAME
columns.description: Flag raised if the associated invoice is a Resubmission.

columns.name: RECORD_NAME
columns.description: The name of the Claim Reference Data record.

columns.name: PRIMARY_LINK_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: The instant a Primary record was linked to the Claim Reference Data record.

columns.name: CANCELLED_BY_PROV_FLAG_C_NAME
columns.description: Indicates whether the associated invoice has been cancelled by the submitter.

columns.name: PAT_MRN
columns.description: The patient's medical record number.

columns.name: FILING_ORDER_C_NAME
columns.description: Stores the providers claim filing order.

columns.name: REF_DATA_CLAIM_PRINT_ID
columns.description: The claim print record for which the CRF record is generated from. This item is only populated on a shared instance implementation of CRF.

columns.name: PROV_CLM_RECON
columns.description: The Claim Reconciliation (CRD) record id in the provider system's Epic instance. This is not a networked item and does not link to a Claim Reconciliation record.
